name: Raceway Ruins
summary: The Mirage Raceway sits on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles, a wide salt flat where gnome and goblin pit crews test experimental rocket cars. Across these cracked salt pans, racers compete fiercely, frequently leaving scattered rocket car parts and twisted chassis behind in the dust.

sections.title: A Boneyard of High Speeds
sections.body: Speed and explosive ambition drive everything on the Shimmering Flats. Gnomes and goblins have established a sprawling raceway over the dried salt bed, testing volatile engines in a race for engineering bragging rights. Between crashes, mechanical mishaps, and relentless rivalries, pieces of shattered rocket cars litter the outskirts of the track, often salvaged by scavengers, scorpids, and passing opportunists.

faq.answer: The Mirage Raceway is an expansive racing track set on the dried salt beds of the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles. It was founded as neutral ground where goblin and gnome engineers pit their fastest, most volatile rocket cars against each other.

faq.q: Why are there broken car parts scattered around?
faq.answer: Gnomish and goblin engineering favors extreme performance over basic safety. High-speed collisions, catastrophic engine detonations, and chaotic trial runs constantly shed parts across the salt flats, leaving valuable scrap scattered for scavengers.

faq.q: Who works and races out here?
faq.answer: Rival teams of gnomes and goblins dominate the flats, supported by pit crews, grease monkeys, and neutral vendors. While their respective factions may be hostile elsewhere, here the shared pursuit of raw horsepower creates a tenuous, noisy peace.

angles.text: The salt flats are a showcase of peak engineering madness, featuring experimental rocket propulsion, mechanical superchargers, and the wreckage to prove it.
For gnomes, the raceway is a proving ground to demonstrate precise craftsmanship over crude goblin volatile mixtures, though both often end in explosions.
